description: Na₂Nb₄O₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.77 Å. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-48°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.48 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.06 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NbO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-48°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.34 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.18 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Nb atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONaNb₃ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Nb atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Nb atoms.
